s: The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index was developed in which year?
x: The Global MPI was developed in 2010. It replaced the Human Poverty Index as a broader measure of multidimensional deprivation.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's position in the Global MPI 2022:
1. The headcount ratio of multidimensional poverty was 16.4% in 2019–21.
2. Approximately 234 million people were multidimensionally poor.
3. The headcount ratio had declined from 55.1% in 2005–06.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: All three statements are correct. The headcount ratio fell from 55.1% in 2005–06 to 16.4% in 2019–21, representing about 234 million people in poverty in the latter period.
tq: Statement combination testing a percentage, an approximate population and a trend.
